entryCopy.tr: Her görev atışından önce SOL veya SAĞ de. Yakalayan paddle’ı o tarafa alır; mavi yüz topa dönük kalır. Düz, yumuşak atışla o paddle’ı hedefle. Yalnız söylenen taraftaki mavi yüze yapışan top doğru yakalama sayılır. Boş elle ayırıp normal geri pas ver; geri pas sayılmaz ve çağrı gerektirmez. Aynı çağıranın 5 görev atışından sonra roller değişir; geri paslar bu 5’e dahil değildir.
entryCopy.en-US: Call LEFT or RIGHT before each challenge toss. The catcher moves the paddle to that side with its blue side facing the ball. Toss straight and gently at that paddle. Only a catch on the paddle on the called side counts as correct. Take the ball off with the free hand and make a neutral return; it needs no call and does not count. Switch roles after the same caller’s 5 challenge tosses; returns are excluded.

steps: Before each challenge toss, the caller says “Left” or “Right.”
The catcher moves the paddle to that side of their own body, with the blue side facing the ball.
The caller tosses straight and gently toward that paddle, never toward the person’s body.
The catch counts as correct only if the ball sticks to the blue side on the called side.
The catcher takes the ball off with their free hand and makes a normal return pass. Returns need no call and do not count.
The same caller makes 5 challenge tosses, then you switch roles. Do not include return passes in those 5.
en-US.goal: Make 8 correct catches on the called side.
en-US.safety: Aim at the blue paddle face on the called side, never at the person. Keep tosses straight and gentle.
en-US.setup: 2 players, 2 paddles, 1 ball. Left and right mean the catcher’s own left and right.

steps: Catch the ball on the blue side with the hand wearing the paddle.
Use your free hand to take the ball off.
Pass the ball to the hand that is still wearing the paddle.
Carefully slide that hand out of the strap.
Put the paddle on your other hand and secure the strap.
The hand holding the ball is now free. Use it to make a gentle toss.
Make your next catch with the other paddle hand. Repeat this whole hand switch after every clean catch.

en-US.safety: Take your time switching hands. Never toss the paddle between hands or change hands with the ball still stuck to it. There is no handle.

If the middle player catches the ball on the paddle, they walk over and trade places with the person who threw it.
en-US.goal: Make 6 catches in the middle. Everyone gets a turn.
en-US.safety: Keep tosses below face level. Walk when trading places. Do not dive for the ball.

steps: Catch the ball on the blue side.
Take the ball off with your free hand and keep it in that hand.
Use the hand wearing the paddle to show your chosen signal to the next catcher.
Wait until they see the signal, then toss gently with your free hand. No signal means no toss.
en-US.goal: Make 10 catches with your secret signal.
en-US.safety: Choose a simple paddle signal that is easy to see. You do not need finger gestures. Use only 1 ball.
en-US.setup: Use 1 ball. Before starting, choose a simple paddle signal, such as briefly raising the paddle or gently tilting it to the side. With 2 players, pass A ↔ B. With 3 players, pass A → B → C → A.
